fields.name: target_before_button
fields.description: The [y, x] of the target that the demonstration placed the cube on immediately before the button was pressed. Found by reading the whole demonstration: locate the first demonstration frame where the fingers go to 0% open (the gripper then descends onto the button and the button's y shifts, that is the press); take the last cube release before that frame (fingers widen from ~46% to ~100% while the gripper is low, height under 0.05); the cube's position at that release is the placement point; the field holds the coordinates of the target entry nearest that placement point as listed in the scene at the start of execution. Written at the first decision step and never changed afterwards. e.g. [126, 145]

fields.name: cube_placed
fields.description: Whether the robot itself has already dropped the goal cube onto target_before_button during execution. 'no' at every step until the decision step whose execution steps show the robot release the cube (fingers widen back to ~100% while low) with the cube lying within about 6 pixels of target_before_button; 'yes' from that step on. e.g. no
